implementation_summary: fillProposal already uses options.language for AuditDoc.language and falls back to English wording and templates for languages without their own entry, so proposal.ts needed no change. settings.ts builds no AuditDoc. Added a regression test showing that fillProposal with English labels and language 'hi' returns doc.language 'hi' with English wording. The remaining defect is generate.ts:86, which passes lookup.language instead of the requested language; I do not own that file.
tests_proposed: generate.ts-level test: a Hindi Proposal carries language 'hi' and the Beta translation note once generate.ts:86 is fixed
risks: generate.ts:86 (not owned) must change to lookup.requested ?? lookup.language, otherwise the Hindi Proposal gets no beta note. generate.ts:77-82 already uses lookup.requested for the other documents.
handoff: Whoever owns generate.ts should set the fillProposal option language to lookup.requested ?? lookup.language at line 86. fillProposal then returns doc.language as the requested language and keeps the English wording. Keep the template lookup on lookup.language, as it is now.
